verdict.rationale: Jira's own feature pages describe agile sprint templates, boards, burndown charts and capacity management, and support prioritizing and breaking down work. These cover the core of planning and running sprints. A community user's mention of closed sprints confirms the feature exists in practice, though that user found past-sprint contents hard to review. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of sprint planning mechanics (backlog grooming, sprint start/complete, scope changes), and hands-on corroboration that sprint management works well.
